# Psalm 40 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 40:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Of-David. A-psalm.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 40:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-He-brought-me-up from-a-pit of-destruction, from-the-miry clay, and-He-set my-feet upon a-rock, establishing my-steps.
- **LOGOS:** He drew me up from the pit of destruction, out of the miry bog, and set my feet upon a rock, making my steps secure.
- **PNEUMA:** He lifted me out of the pit of despair, out of the mud and the mire. He set my feet on solid ground and steadied me as I walked along.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 40:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Sacrifice and-offering You-did-not desire — ears You-dug for-me — burnt-offering and-sin-offering You-did-not ask.
- **LOGOS:** In sacrifice and offering You have not delighted, but You have given me an open ear. Burnt offering and sin offering You have not required.
- **PNEUMA:** You take no delight in sacrifices or offerings. Now that You have made me listen, I finally understand — You don't require burnt offerings or sin offerings.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 40:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** To-do Your-will, my-God, I-desire, and-Your-Torah [is] within my-inward-parts.'
- **LOGOS:** I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.'
- **PNEUMA:** I take joy in doing Your will, my God, for Your instructions are written on my heart.'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 40:12 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You, YHWH, will-not withhold Your-compassions from-me; Your-steadfast-love and-Your-truth continually preserve-me.
- **LOGOS:** As for You, O LORD, You will not restrain Your mercy from me; Your steadfast love and Your faithfulness will ever preserve me!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, don't hold back Your tender mercies from me. Let Your unfailing love and faithfulness always protect me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 40:14 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Be-pleased, YHWH, to-deliver-me; YHWH, hasten to-my-help.
- **LOGOS:** Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me! O LORD, make haste to help me!
- **PNEUMA:** Please, LORD, rescue me! Come quickly, LORD, and help me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
